m: सं-नाद m. (sg. and pl.) shouting together, a confused or tumultuous noise, uproar, din, clamour (also -शब्द), MBh.; R. &c.
सं-नाद m. N. of a monkey, R.
सं-˚नादन mfn. (fr. Caus.) making to sound, filling with noise or clamour, MBh.
सं-˚नादन m. N. of a monkey, R.
सं-˚नादित mfn. (fr. id.) caused to resound, filled with noise or cries, MBh.; R.
सं-नाह m. tying up, girding on (esp. armour), arming for battle, MBh.; R.; VarBṛS.
making one's self ready, preparation, Daś.
equipment, harness, ib.; Kathās.
accoutrements, armour, mail, a coat of mail (made of iron or quilted cotton), AitBr. &c. &c.
a cord, string, MBh.
a: संनाहः — 1 Arming(oneself) or preparation for battle, putting on armour. --2 Warlike preparation, equipment; संनाहोयं साहसमवगमयति Dk. --3 Armour, mail; अस्मिन्कलौ खलोत्सृष्टदुष्टवाग्बाणदारुणे . कथं जीवेज्जगन्न स्युः संनाहाः सज्जना यदि Kīr. K. 1. 36, Ki. 16. 12.

m: सं-˚नाह्य m. ‘armed or ready for battle’, a war elephant, L.
a: संनाह्यः — A war-elephant.

m: सं-नाम m. bowing down, submission, Nalod.
changing, L.
सं-˚नामयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be rendered submissive, Divyāv.
सं-नाय्य w.r. for सांन्˚, q.v.

सं-√ नी P. -नयति, to lead or bring or put together, join, connect, unite, conglomerate, RV.; TS.; Āpast.; BhP.; to mix together, mingle, mix (esp. with sweet or sour milk), ŚBr.; Kauś.; Mn. &c.; to lead or direct towards, bring, procure, bestow, TS.; Br.; MBh.; to present with (instr.), RV.; to bring back, restore, pay, RV.; AV.; Br.; Mn.; to direct (the mind) towards (loc.), BhP.
a: संनी — {c1c} P. 1 To bring together. --2 To rule, govern, guide. --3 To restore, give back. --4 To lead towards, lead, or bring near to. --5 To connect, unite. --6 To mingle, mix. --7 To arrange. --8 To obtain, procure.

m: सं-नख mfn. ‘having the nails (of fingers and thumb) brought into contact’, tightly closed
सं-नख m. (with मुष्टि) as much as can be grasped, a handful, ĀpŚr.; Car.
सं-√ नश् (only in Ved. inf. संनशे), to reach, attain, RV.; VS.
सं-√ नद् P. -नदति, to cry aloud, sound, roar, MBh. : Caus. -नादयति, to cause to resound, fill with noise or cries, MBh.; R.; Hariv.; to cry aloud, MBh.
सं-नद्ध See सं-√ नह्.
सं-नद्ध mfn. bound or fastened or tied together, girt, bound, RV. &c. &c.
armed, mailed, equipped, accoutred, RV. &c. &c.
harnessed, AitBr.
prepared, ready, Rājat.
ready to discharge water (said of a cloud), Megh.; Vikr.
ready to blossom (as a bud), Śak.
wearing amulets, provided with charms, W.
sticking or clinging or adhering to, pervading (loc.), Kālid.
adjoining, bordering, near, R.
a: संनद्ध — p. p. 1 Tied or bound together, girded or put on. --2 Clad or dressed in armour, accoutred, mailed. --3 Arranged, ready, or prepared, for battle, armed, fully equipped; नवजलधरः संनद्धोऽयं न दृप्तनिशाचरः V. 4. 1; कः संनद्धे विरहविधुरां त्वय्युपेक्षेत जायां Me. 8. --4 Ready, prepared, formed, arranged in general; लतेव संनद्धमनोज्ञपल्लवा R. 3. 7. --5 Pervading; कुसुममिव लोभनीयं यौवनमंगेषु संनद्धं Ś. 1. 21. --6 Wellprovided with anything. --7 Murderous. --8 Closely attached, bordering, near. --9 Ready to burst or blossom. --10 Provided with charms.

k.v: आमुक्तः प्रतिमुक्तश्च पिनद्धश्चापिनद्धवत्. संनद्धो वर्मितः सज्जो दंशितो व्युढकङ्कटः॥

m: सं-नद्ध—कवच mfn. one who has girded on his armour, clad in mail or accoutred, Kāṭh.
सं-नद्धव्य n. (impers.) it is to be girded or fastened or made ready, MBh.

सं-√ नह् P. Ā. -नह्यति, ˚ते, to bind or tie together, bind or fasten on, put or gird on (acc.), clothe or furnish with (instr.), AV. &c. &c.; (Ā.) to put anything (acc.) on one's self, dress or arm one's self with (e.g. संनह्यध्वं चारूणि दंशनानि, ‘put ye on your beautiful armour’), ib.; to prepare for doing anything (inf.), Bhartṛ. : Pass. -नह्यते, to be fastened on &c., be harnessed, MBh.; Hariv. : Caus. -नाहयति, to cause to gird or bind on, cause to equip or arm one's self, GṛŚrS.
a: संनह् — {c4c} U. 1 To tie, bind, fasten. --2 To wear, put on, dress. --3 To put on (as armour), arm oneself, be accoutred; समनात्सीत्ततो सैन्यं Bk. 15. 111, 112; 14. 7; 16. 4. --4 To make oneself ready, prepare oneself (for any action) (Atm. in this sense); युद्धाय संनह्यते Mbh.; छेत्तुं वज्रमणीञ् शिरीषकुसुमप्रांतेन संनह्यते Bk. 2. 6.

m: सं-˚नहनीय w.r. for सं-हननीय, MBh.
सं-नहन n. tying or stringing together, Nir.; ĀśvGṛ.
preparing, making one's self ready, Hariv.
a band, cord, rope, TBr.; ŚrS.; MBh.
equipment, armour, mail, MBh.; R.
a: संनहनं — 1 Preparing, equipping, arming oneself. --2 Preparation. --3 Fastening tightly. --4 Industry, effort.

m: सं-√ नम् P. Ā. -नमति, ˚ते, to bend together, bend down, bow down before or to (dat. gen., or acc. of person), MBh.; R.; (Ā.) to submit or conform to, comply with, obey (dat.), RV.; TS.; VS.; to direct, bend in the right direction, put in order, arrange, prepare, make ready, RV.; AV.; VS.; Br. (Ā.) to be brought, about or fulfilled, VS.; (P. Ā.) : Caus. -नामयति or -नमयति, to bend, cause to bow or sink, MBh.; Kum.; BhP.; to bend in a particular direction, make right, arrange, prepare, bring about, AV.; ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.; to subdue, Divyāv.
सं-नम् f. favour, kindness, AV. iv, 39, 1.
a: संनम् — {c1c} P. 1 To bend, stoop, incline; संनतांगी Ku. 1. 34; Bk. 2. 31; पर्वसु संनता V. 4. 26. --2 To submit or subject oneself to, obey; संनमतामरीणां R. 18. 34. --3 To bend down, bow down to. --4 To make ready, prepare. --5 To be accomplished. --Caus. 1 To contract, bend together. --2 To cause to bend or stoop. --3 To make ready, prepare.

m: सं-˚नमन n. bending together, narrowing, KātyŚr., Sch.
सं-नमस्य Nom. P. ˚स्यति, to show respect or honour, worship, Hariv.
सं-√ नर्द् P. -नर्दति (ep. also ˚ते), to roar aloud, bellow, MBh.
सं-√ नस् Ā. -नसते, to come together, meet, be united, RV.
सं-न˚ताङ्ग mf(ई)n. having the body bent, having rounded limbs, Kum. i, 34.
सं-नत &c. See सं-√ नम्.
सं-नत mfn. bent together, curved, stooping or bowing to (gen.), MBh.; R. &c.
bowed, before, revered, BhP.
deepened, sunk in, depressed, Śulbas.; MBh. &c.
bent down through sorrow, dispirited, downcast, R.
(सं-), du. conforming to or harmonizing with each other, VS.
सं-नत m. N. of a monkey, R.
a: संनत — p. p. 1 Bent down, stooping. --2 Downcast. --3 Contracted.

m: सं-नत—भ्रू mfn. bending or contracting the brow, frowning, MBh.
सं-नत—तर mfn. more deepened, deeper, KātyŚr., Sch.
सं-˚नतेयु m. N. of a son of Raudrāśva (cf. सं-ततेयु), MBh.; Hariv.
सं-नति f. bending down, depression, lowness, Śiś.
inclination, leaning towards, favour, complaisance towards (gen.), ib.
N. of verses expressing favour or respect (e.g. AV. iv, 39, 1), Kauś.
subjection or submission to, humility towards (loc.), MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
Humility personified (as a daughter of Devala and wife of Brahma-datta or as a daughter of Dakṣa and wife of Kratu), Hariv.; Pur.
diminishing, lightening (of a burden), Hariv.
sound, noise, L.
सं-नति m. N. of a son of Su-mati, Hariv.
of a son of Alarka, ib.
a: संनतिः — f. 1 Obeisance, respectful salutation, reverence. --2 Stooping posture, crouching. --3 Humility. --4 A kind of sacrifice. --5 A sound, noise.

m: सं-नति—होम m. N. of partic. oblations (cf. संतति-ह्˚), TBr.
सं-नति—मत् mfn. humble, modest towards (gen.), Hariv.
सं-नति—मत् m. N. of a son of Su-mati, Pur.
सं-नय &c. See सं-√ नी.
सं-नय mfn. leading or bringing together, RV.
सं-नय m. a collection, assembly, MBh.
the rear of an army, rearguard, L.
a: संनयः — 1 A collection, multitude, quantity, number. --2 Rear, rearguard (of an army).

m: सं-˚नयन n. leading or bringing together, Kauś.
a: संनयनं — 1 Bringing together or near. --2 Connecting, uniting.

m: सं-नष्ट mfn. (√ 2. नश्) entirely disappeared, perished, R.
सं-नेय mfn. to be led or brought together, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 129, Sch.
सं-√ नृत् P. -नृत्यति, to dance together, AV.
सं-निभ mfn. like, similar, resembling (ifc.; often pleonastically with names of colours, e.g. पीतारुण-स्˚ = पीतारुण), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संनिभ — a. Like, similar (at the end of comp.); Rs. 1. 11.

m: सं-निभृत mfn. (√ भृ) well kept secret, concealed, hidden, Hit. (v.l.)
discreet, prudent, modest, BhP.

सं-नि-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to put or place down near together, put down near or into, deposit in (loc.), place or put upon, direct towards (with or without दृष्टिम्, ‘to fix the eyes upon’; with मनस्, or हृदयम्, ‘to fix or direct the mind or thoughts’), TS. &c. &c.; to place together, collect, pile up, MBh.; (Ā.) to appoint to (loc.), PraśnUp.; (Ā.) to be present in, be found with (loc.), Daś.; (Ā. or Pass. -धीयते) to be put together in the same place, be near or present or imminent, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.: Caus. -धापयति, to bring near, make present or manifest, represent, BhP. : Pass. of Caus. -धाप्यते, to appear or become manifested in the presence of (gen.), ib.
a: संनिधा — {c3c} U. 1 To place, put, or keep together; Ms. 2. 186. --2 To place near; Ś. 3. 19. --3 To fix upon, direct towards; (दृष्टिं) पुनः सहस्रार्चिषि संनिधत्ते R. 13. 44. --4 To draw near, approach. --5 To collect, pile up. --6 To observe, inspect. --Pass. To be near, be present. --Caus. To collect, bring together, assemble; U. 7.

m: सं-निधान n. juxtaposition, nearness, vicinity, presence (ए, with gen. or ifc., ‘in the presence of, near’; आत्, with gen., ‘from [one's presence]’; ˚न-तस् ifc. ‘towards’), R.; Hariv. &c.
presence = existence (cf. अ-स्˚), Rājat.
placing down, depositing, W.
a place of deposit, receptacle, gathering-place, rallying-point, MBh.; Bhartṛ.; BhP.
receiving, taking charge of ib.
a: संनिधानं, संनिधिः — 1 Putting down together, juxta-position. --2 Proximity, vicinity, presence; N. 2. 53. --3 Perceptibility, appearance. --4 A receptacle. --5 Receiving, taking charge of. --6 Combination, aggregate; Pt. 1. 191. --7 Depositing. --8 The object of an organ of sense (इंद्रियविषय).

m: सं-˚निधानिन् mfn. (perhaps) gathering together or collecting (goods &c.), Divyāv.
सं-निधातृ mfn. one who places down near, one who is near or close at hand (f. ˚त्री = fut. ‘she will be present’), Naiṣ.
depositing, placing in deposit, W.
receiving in charge, MW.
सं-निधातृ m. a receiver of stolen goods, Mn. ix, 278
an officer who introduces people at court, Pañcat.; Rājat.
= क्षत्तृ, ŚBr., Sch.
a: संनिधातृ — m. 1 One who brings near. --2 One who deposits. --3 A receiver of stolen goods; Ms. 9. 278. --4 An officer who introduces people at court. --5 One who receives in charge.

m: सं-निधायिन् mfn. being near or close at hand, present, Mālatīm.
सं-निध n. juxtaposition, vicinity, L.
सं-निधि m. depositing together or near, KātyŚr.; Sāh.

juxtaposition, nearness, vicinity, presence (औ, with gen. or ifc., ‘in the presence of, near’; इम्, ‘near to, towards’; id., with √ कृ, वि-√ धा or √ बन्ध् and loc., ‘to take one's seat or place or abode in’), ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
visibility, existence (cf. अ-स्˚), Kusum.
receiving, taking charge of W.
सं-निधि—कार m. laying aside (food for one's self), Buddh.
सं-निधि—वर्तिन् mfn. being near, neighbouring, MW.
सं-निधि—वियोग m. separation (of vicinity), Mālav.
सं-नि-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति, to rub or mix together, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
सं-नि-√ शम् (only ind.p. -शाम्य or -शम्य), to perceive, hear, learn, MBh.; Kathās.
सं-निश्चय m. a settled opinion (acc. with √ या, ‘to make up one's mind’), MBh.
सं-नि-श्रय m. (√ श्रि) support (see किम्-स्˚).
सं-निश्रित mfn. connected with, devoted to, Divyāv.

a: संनिबंधः — 1 Binding firmly. --2 Connection, attachment. --3 Effectiveness.

m: सं-नि-बद्ध mfn. (√ बन्ध्) firmly bound together or on, closely connected with or attached to, dependent on or engrossed by (loc.), R.; BrahmaP.
(ifc.) planted or covered with, MBh.
सं-निबन्ध m. binding firmly together or on, tying together, W.
attachment, connection, consequence, ib.
effectiveness, ib.
सं-˚निबन्धन n. the act of lying firmly or binding fast, ib.
सं-निबर्हण n. the act of overthrowing or subduing, Kām.
सं-निबोद्धव्य mfn. to be thoroughly perceived or understood, VarBṛS.
सं-नि-√ बुध् P. -बोधति, to perceive completely or thoroughly, MārkP.
सं-नि-चय m. (√ 1. चि) piling or heaping together, gathering, collecting, MBh.
store, provision (see अल्प-स्˚).
a: संनिचयः — A collection.

m: सं-निचित mfn. heaped together &c.
congested, constipated, stagnated, Suśr.
सं-निदाघ m. scorching heat (esp. of the sun), BhP.
सं-निदर्शित mfn. (fr. Caus. of √ दृश्) brought into view, shown, pointed out, R.
सं-नि-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go or come together, meet or unite with (instr.), ŚBr.
सं-नि-√ ग्रह् P. -गृह्णाति, to hold down, keep under, overcome, subdue, MBh.; VarBṛS.; to lay hold of, seize, MBh.; to check, curb, restrain, suppress, ib.
सं-निग्रह m. restraint, punishment, MBh.
सं-नि-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike at, strike, kill, MBh.
सं-निहन n. (used to explain सं-निहती), MBh.
सं-निहती f. N. of a river, Prāyaśc.
of a Tīrtha, MBh.
सं-निहि˚तापाय mfn. having loss or destruction near at hand, transient, transitory, fleeting, Hit.
सं-निहित mfn. deposited together or near, contiguous, proximate, present, close, near, at hand, MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.
deposited, fixed, laid up (see हृदय-स्˚)
prepared to, ready for (dat.), Śak.
staying, being, W.
सं-निहित m. a partic. Agni, MBh.
a: संनिहित — p. p. 1 Placed near, lying close, near, contiguous, neighbouring; Ś. 4. --2 Close, proximate, at hand. --3 Present; अपि संनिहितोऽत्र कुलपतिः Ś. 1; हृदयसंनिहिते Ś. 3. 19. --4 Fixed, placed, deposited. --5 Prepared, ready; Mu. 1. --6 Staying or being in. --तं Proximity, vicinity. --Comp. --अपाय a. having destruction close at hand, frail, perishable, transitory; कायः संनिहितापायः Pt. 2. 177.

m: सं-निहित—तर-त्व n. greater nearness, Gobh., Sch.
सं-नि-√ काश् Caus. -काशयति, to make quite clear, manifest, reveal, announce, declare, make known, MBh.; Kir. xiii, 35.
सं-निकाश mf(आ)n. having the appearance of, resembling (comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
सं-नि-कीर्ण mfn. (√ कॄ) stretched out at full length, Megh.

सं-निकर्ष m. drawing near or together, approximation, close contact, nearness, neighbourhood, proximity, vicinity (ए, ‘in the vicinity of, near’, with gen. or comp.; आत्, ‘from the neighbourhood or proximity of’), Nir.; GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c. (-ता f., Kusum.)

connection with, relation to, (in phil.) the connection of an Indriya or organ of sense with its Viṣaya or object (this accord. to the Nyāya, is the source of ज्ञान, and is of two kinds, 1. लौकिक, which is sixfold, 2. अ-लौकिक, which is threefold, MW.), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.
a receptacle, repository, BhP.
सं-निकर्ष mfn. near, at hand, Hariv.
a: संनिकर्षः — 1 Drawing near, bringing near. --2 Vicinity, proximity; presence; उत्कंठते च युष्मत्संनिकर्षस्य U. 6; Ku. 3. 74; R. 7. 8, 6. 20. --3 Connection, relation. --4 (In Nyāya phil.) Connection of an organ of sense (इंद्रिय) with its object (विषय); this is of six kinds.

m: सं-˚निकर्षण n. drawing together, approximation, close contact with (instr.), BhP.
a: संनिकर्षणं — 1 Bringing near. --2 Approaching, approximating. --3 Proximity, vicinity. --4 Relation, connection. --5 Connection of an organ of sense with its object; see संनिकर्ष (4) above.

m: सं-निकर्ष—ता f., Kusum.
सं-निकर्ष—ता-वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-निकर्ष—तत्त्व-विवेक m. N. of wk.
सं-निकर्ष—वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
सं-निकर्ष—वाद m. N. of wk.
सं-निकर्ष—विचार m. N. of wk.
सं-नि-√ कृष् (ind.p. -कृष्य See below) Pass. -कृष्यते, to come into close or immediate contact wish (instr.), Nyāyas., Sch.
सं-निकृष्ट mfn. drawn together or near, contiguous, proximate, near, imminent, MBh.; R. &c.
one who takes up the same or a similar position, Kathās.
सं-निकृष्ट n. nearness, vicinity (˚ष्टे ind. ‘in the neighbourhood of’, with gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: संनिकृष्ट — p. p. 1 Approximate. --2 Proximate, adjacent, near. --ष्टं Proximity, vicinity.

m: सं-निकृष्टे ind., ‘in the neighbourhood of’, with gen. or comp.
सं-˚निकृष्य ind. approaching, coming near, Daś.
सं-नि-√ कुञ्च् (only ind.p. -कुञ्च्य), to draw together, contract, Siṃhās.
सं-निक्षार m. the Piyāla tree, W.
सं-नि-√ क्षिप् P. -क्षिपति, to throw or lay down, R.
सं-नि-√ ली Ā. -लीयते, to settle down, alight, MBh.; to cower down, hide or conceal one's self, disappear, R.
सं-नि-√ मील् P. -मीलति, to entirely close, completely shut (the eyes), MBh.
सं-निमग्न mfn. sunk entirely under, immersed, W.
sleeping, asleep, ib.
सं-नि-√ मज्ज् P. -मज्जति, to sink entirely under, sink down, be immersed, MBh.
सं-नि-√ मन्त्र् P. -मन्त्रयति, to invite, MBh.
सं-नि-√ नी (only ind.p. -नीय), to bring or pour together, mix, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
सं-निपात m. falling in or down together, collapse, meeting, encounter, contact or collision with (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
conjunction, aggregation, combination, mixture, Prāt.; ŚrS.; MBh. &c.
(also with मैथुने) sexual intercourse with (loc.), Āpast.; MBh.
a complicated derangement of the three humours or an illness produced by it, Suśr.
a partic. manner of wrestling, VP.
falling down, descent (see लक्षण-स्˚)
utter collapse, death, destruction, MBh.
(in astron.) a partic. conjunction of planets, VarBṛS.
(in music) a kind of measure, Saṃgīt.
a: संनिपातः — 1 Falling down, alighting, descent. --2 Falling together, meeting; confluence; समुद्रपत्न्योर्जलसंनिपाते R. 13. 58. --3 Collision, contact. --4 Union, conjunction, combination, mixture, miscellaneous collection; धूमज्योतिःसलिलमरुतां संनिपातः क्व मेघः Me. 5. --5 An assemblage, a collection, multitude, number; नानारत्नज्योतिषां संनिपातैः Ki. 5. 36; एको हि दोषो गुणसंनिपाते निमज्जति Ku. 1. 3. --6 Arrival. --7 A combined derangement of the three humours of the body causing fever which is of a dangerous kind. --8 A kind of musical time or measure. --Comp. --ज्वरः fever arising from a vitiated state of the three humours of the body.

m: सं-निपात—चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk.
सं-निपात—चिकित्सा f. N. of wk.
सं-निपात—ज्वर m. a dangerous fever resulting from morbid condition of the three humours (one of the 8 kinds of fever), Suśr.
सं-˚निपातक m. (in med.) = ˚निपात, Suśr.
a: संनिपातकः — = संनिपात (7) above.

m: सं-निपात—कलिका f. N. of wk.
सं-निपात—कलिका-टीका f. N. of wk.
सं-निपात—मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
सं-निपात—नाडी-लक्षण n. N. of wk.
सं-˚निपातन n. (fr. Caus.) causing to fall together, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सं-निपात—निद्रा f. a swoon, trance, Kād.
सं-निपात—नुद् m. ‘removing the above fever’, a species of Nimba tree, Suśr.
सं-निपात—पट m. n. (?) N. of wk.
सं-˚निपातिक w.r. for सांन्˚ (q.v.)
सं-˚निपातिन् mfn. falling together, meeting (˚ति-त्व n.), ĀpŚr., Sch.
furthering or promoting immediately, Nyāyam., Sch.
सं-˚निपातित mfn. (fr. Caus.) thrown or shot down, discharged, R.
brought or called together, assembled, MBh.
सं-˚निपाति-त्व n.
सं-˚निपात्य mfn. (fr. Caus.), to be caused to fall down, to be hurled upon (loc.), Śak.

सं-नि-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fly or fall down, alight, descend upon (loc.), MBh.; R.; Hariv.; to come together, meet, fall in with (instr. with or without सह), Āpast.; Megh.; to present one's self, arrive, appear among or in (loc.), Vajracch.; to perish, be destroyed, MBh. : Caus. -पातयति, to cause to fall down, shoot down or off, discharge, MBh.; R.; to cause to come together, join, unite, assemble, convoke, GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.; to stretch out (a cord) to (loc.), Śulbas.
a: संनिपत् — {c1c} P. 1 To alight, descend. --2 To come together, assemble, meet together. --3 To fall upon, attack; U. 3. 6. --4 To arrive, appear. --5 To perish, be destroyed. --Caus. 1 To throw or shoot down, discharge. --2 To convoke, convene, assemble, collect together.

m: सं-निपतित mfn. flown or fallen down, descended &c.
met together, assembled, Kāraṇḍ.
appeared, arrived, MBh.
सं-˚निपत्य ind. having flown or fallen down &c.
immediately, directly (see comp.)
सं-˚निपत्य—कारिन् mfn. acting immediately, Nyāyam.
सं-˚निप˚त्योपकारक mfn. directly effective, Madhus.
सं-निर्-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go out together, go away, start, depart, MBh.
सं-निर्-√ मथ् (only ind.p. -मथ्य), to churn out, stir or shake about together, crush together, Pañcar.
सं-निर्-मित mfn. (√ 3. मा) constructed, composed of (abl.), AitBr.
सं-˚निरोध m. restraint, obstruction, suppression, Suśr.; MBh.; BhP.
confinement, imprisonment, BhP.
narrowness, a narrow pass (in पर्वत-स्˚), MBh.
a: संनिरोधः — Obstruction, hindrance.

m: सं-˚निरोद्धव्य mfn. to be shut up or confined, Mn. ix, 83.

सं-नि-√ रुध् P. -रुणद्धि, to keep back, restrain, hinder, check, stop, obstruct, suppress, MBh.; Hariv.; to shut in, confine, ŚvetUp.; Hariv.; BhP.; to withdraw (the senses from the outer world), Yājñ. : Pass. -रुध्यते, to be kept back &c., MBh.
a: संनिरुध् — See निरुध्.

m: सं-निरुद्ध mfn. kept back, held fast, restrained, suppressed, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
raked together (as fire), R.
crowded, filled, covered over, MBh.; Hariv.
सं-निरुद्ध—गुद m. obstruction of the lower intestine, Suśr.
सं-निर्-√ वप् P. -वपति, to scatter about, distribute, dispense, AitBr.
सं-नि-सूदित mfn. (√ सूद्) altogether killed, destroyed, MBh. (B. -षूदित).
सं-निसर्ग m. good-naturedness, gentleness, MBh.
सं-नि-सृष्ट mfn. (√ सृज्) delivered up or over, intrusted, committed, MBh.
सं-निताल m. (in music) a kind of time or measure, Saṃgīt.
सं-˚निवाप m. the heaping together or mingling (of fires), Āpast.
सं-निवारण , ˚र्य. See col. 3.
सं-निवारण n. keeping back, restrained, MBh.
सं-˚निवार्य mfn. to be kept back or restrained, ib.
सं-निवास m. (for सन्-न्˚ See p. 1137, col. 3) dwelling or living together, BhP.
common habitation, a nest, MBh.
सं-˚निवासिन् mfn. dwelling, inhabiting (see वन-स्˚).
सं-नि-वाय m. (√ वे) connection, combination, BhP.
सं-नि-√ वप् P. -वपति, to throw or heap together, heap up, AitBr.
सं-˚निवपनीय mfn. connected with the piling up (of the sacrificial fire), ŚāṅkhBr.
सं-निवपन n. heaping together, piling up (see next).
सं-निवर्तन &c. See सं-नि√ वृत्, col. 3.
सं-निवर्तन n. (also pl.) turning back, return, MBh.; R.
सं-˚निवर्तित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to return, sent back or away, MārkP.
सं-नि-√ वस् Ā. -वस्ते, to clothe with, put on (clothes &c.), MBh.
सं-नि-√ वस् P. -वसति, to dwell or live together with (instr.), MBh.; to live in, inhabit (loc.), ib.
सं-निवेश m. entering or sitting down together, entrance into, settlement (acc. with √ कृ or वि-√ धा, ‘to take up a position, settle down’), Kāv.; Suśr.
seat, position, situation (ifc. ‘situated in or on’), Suśr.; Kālid.; Vās.
station, encampment, abode, place, Kāv.; Kathās.
vicinity, W.
an open place or play-ground in or near a town (where people assemble for recreation), L.
assembling together, assembly, crowd, Prasannar.
causing to enter, putting down together, W.
insertion, inclusion, Hcat.
attachment to any pursuit, MW.
impression (of a mark; see लक्षण-स्˚)
foundation (of a town), Cat.
putting together, fabrication, construction, composition, arrangement, Kāv.; Pur.; Sāh.
Construction personified (as son of Tvaṣṭṛ and Racanā), BhP.
form, figure, appearance, Ragh.; Uttarar.; BhP.
form of an asterism, W.
a: संनिवेशः — 1 Deep entrance into, ardent devotion or attachment, close application. --2 A collection, multitude, assemblage. --3 Union, combination, arrangement; रमणीय एष वः सुमनसां संनिवेशः Māl. 1. 9. --4 Site, place, situation, position; Ku. 7. 25; R. 6. 19. --5 Vicinity, proximity. --6 Form, figure; उद्दामशरीरसंनिवेशः Māl. 3; निर्माणसंनिवेशः K. --7 A hut, dwelling-place; R. 14. 76. --8 Seating in the proper places, giving seats to; क्रियतां समाजसंनिवेशः U. 7. --9 Insertion. --10 An open space near a town where people assemble for amusement, exercise &c. --11 The collective position of an asterism.

k.v: क्षिप्ते मुखं निःसरणं संनिवेशो निकर्षणम्. समौ संवसथग्रामौ वेश्मभूर्वास्तुरस्त्रियाम्.।

m: सं-˚निवेशन n. (fr. Caus.) settlement, dwelling place, abode, MBh.; R.; Kām.
erection (of a statue), VarBṛS.
insertion, arrangement, Sāh.
सं-˚निवेशयितव्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be placed or made to enter or inserted, Śaṃk.
सं-˚निवेशिन् mfn. seated or fixed in (comp.), Suśr.
सं-˚निवेशित mfn. (fr. id.) made to enter in or settle, stationed, encamped, located, R.
entered, impressed, ib.
imposed, committed, intrusted, Śak. (v.l.)
सं-˚निवेश्य mfn. to be put in (loc.), VarBṛS.
to be put on or drawn (with colours), Hcat.
सं-नि-√ वृ Caus. -वारयति, to keep off or back, restrain, MBh.

सं-नि-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to turn back, return from (abl.), MBh.; R. &c.; to desist from (abl.), R.; Pur.; to leave off, cease, stop, BhP.; to pass away, MBh. : Caus. -वर्तयति, to cause to return or turn back, send back, MBh.; R.; to hinder, prevent or divert from (abl.), ib.; to cause to cease, suppress, stop, R.
a: संनिवृत् — {c1c} A. 1 To return, retire. --2 To leave off, cease, stop. --3 To pass away. --Caus. 1 To cause to return, send back. --2 To suppress, stop. --3 To prevent, hinder. --4 To divert, turn away from.

m: सं-निवृत्त mfn. turned or come back, returned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
withdrawn, Megh.
desisted, stopped, ceased, BhP.; Suśr.
a: संनिवृत्त — p. p. 1 Returned. --2 Stopped, ceased. --3 Withdrawing, shrinking from.

m: सं-˚निवृत्ति f. returning, coming back (in अ-स्˚ and अ-भूयः-स्˚), Ragh.
desisting from, forbearance, avoiding, W.
a: संनिवृत्तिः — f. 1 Return; Ś. 6. 9; R. 8. 49; 10. 27. --2 Desisting from. --3 Restraint, check, forbearance.

m: सं-नि-√ विश् Ā. -विशते, to sit or settle down together with, have intercourse or intimate connection with (instr.), MBh. (v.l.) : Caus. -वेशयति, to cause to enter or sit down together, introduce into or lodge in (loc.), Hariv.; R.; to set down, deposit, ib.; to draw up (an army), MBh.; to cause (troops) to encamp, R.; Kathās.; fasten or fix or establish in or on (loc.), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to cast or hurl upon (loc.), MBh.; to found (a city), Hariv.; to appoint to (loc.), MBh.; R. &c.; to intrust or commit anything to (loc.), MārkP.; to direct (the mind) towards (loc.), BhP.
a: संनिविश् — {c6c} A. 1 To enter into, enter deeply. --2 To encamp, sit down. --3 To have intercourse or intimate connection with. --Caus. 1 To place, put. --2 To install or place on; धातोः स्थान इवादेशं सुग्रीवं संन्यवेशयत् R. 12. 58. --3 To unite, join, collect. --4 To introduce, insert, put in. --5 To lodge, locate, station, encamp. --6 To devolve upon, commit to, consign. --7 To found (a town &c.). --8 To fix the mind on. --9 To contemplate, reflect upon.

m: सं-नि-√ विद् Caus. -वेदयति, to cause to know, make known, announce, inform, tell, MBh.; R.; to offer, present (आत्मानम्, ‘one's self’), R.
सं-निविष्ट mfn. seated down together, encamped, assembled, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
fixed in or on, sticking or resting or contained in (loc. or comp.), Up.; MBh. &c.
being on (a road or path loc.), MBh.; R.
dependent on (loc.), R.
entered deeply into, absorbed or engrossed in MW.
contiguous, neighbouring, present, at hand, W.
a: संनिविष्ट — p. p. 1 Entered into. --2 Collected, met together, assembled. --3 Absorbed or engrossed in. --4 Abiding or resting in. --5 Contiguous, near, neighbouring. --6 Eneamped; see संनिविश् above.

m: सं-नियच्छन n. (fr. pres. stem) checking, restraining, guiding (of horses), MBh. viii, 1654.
सं-नि-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to hold together, keep back, restrain, subdue, suppress, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to annihilate, destroy, BhP.
सं-नियम m. exactness, precision, Jaim.; Suśr.
सं-नियन्तृ mfn. one who restrains or chastises, a chastiser (with gen.), Mn. ix, 320.
सं-˚नियत mfn. restrained, controlled, R.
सं-नियोग m. connection with, attachment, application (to any pursuit &c.), W.
appointment, commission, Hariv.; R.
injunction, precept, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 118; 119 Vārtt. 3 Pat.
a: संनियोगः — 1 Union, attachment. --2 Appointment.

m: सं-˚नियोजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) appointed, commissioned, Pañcat.
destined, assigned, ib.
सं-˚नियोज्य mfn. to be appointed or employed or commissioned, Baudh.

सं-नि-√ युज् P. -युनक्ति, to connect with, place or put in (loc.), MārkP.; to appoint, employ, MBh. : Caus. योजयति, to place in or on (loc.), Hariv.; MārkP.; to appoint to, intrust with (loc.; or अर्थम्, अर्थाय ifc.), MBh.; R.
a: संनियुज् — See नियुज्.

m: सं-नियुक्त mfn. attached to, connected with (comp.), Pat.
appointed, employed, Yājñ., Sch.
सं-निषण्ण mfn. settled down, seated, R.
halted, stationary, W.
सं-नि-षद् (√ सद्) to sink or sit down, AV.; MBh.
सं-नि-षेवित mfn. (√ सेव्) served, frequented, inhabited by (instr.), MBh.
सं-निषेव्य mfn. to be attended to or treated medically, MBh.
सं-नि-षिच् (√ सिच्) P. -षिञ्चति to pour into, MBh.
सं-नोदन mfn. driving away, KāśīKh.
सं-˚नोदयितव्य mfn. (fr. Caus.) to be impelled or stimulated, Harav.
सं-√ नु Ā. -नवते, to come together, meet, RV. x, 120, 2.
सं-√ नु Ā. -नवते, to roar or sound together, bellow, bleat, RV.

सं-√ नुद् P. -नुदति, to impel or bring together, AV.; Kauś. : Caus. -नोदयति, to bring together or near, procure, find, MBh.; R.; to push or urge on, impel, MBh.; to drive or scare away (?), MBh. xii, 5443 (Nīlak.)
सं-न्या˚साश्रम-विचार m. N. of wk.
सं-न्या˚साह्निक n. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास m. (ifc. f(आ). ) putting or throwing down, laying aside, resignation, abandonment of (gen. or comp.), MBh.; R.; Sarvad.
renunciation of the world, profession of asceticism, Mn.; MBh. &c.
abstinence from food, L.
giving up the body, sudden death, W.
complete exhaustion, Suśr.
deposit, trust, R.; Mṛcch.
contract, agreement, Kathās.
stake, wager, MBh.
Indian spikenard, L.
a: संन्यासः — 1 Leaving, abandonment. --2 Complete renunciation of the world and its possessions and attachments, abandonment of temporal concerns; काम्यानां कर्मणां त्यागं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः; Bg. 6. 2, 18. 2; Ms. 1. 114; 5. 108. --3 A deposit, trust. --4 A stake or wager in a game. --5 Giving up the body, death. --6 Indian spikenard.

m: सं-न्यास—भेद-निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—धर्म-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—दीपिका f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्राह्य-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण n. assuming or practising asceticism, Pañcar.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—ग्रहण-रत्नमाला f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—कर्म-कारिका f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पद-मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—पल्ली f. (for ˚सि-प्˚?) an ascetic's hut, L.
सं-न्यास—रीति f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यास—वत् mfn. connected with asceticism, L.
सं-न्यास—विधि m.
सं-न्यासि-दर्शन n. N. of a ch. of the PadmaP.
सं-˚न्यासिक in वेद-स्˚ (q.v.)
सं-न्यासिन् mfn. laying aside, giving up, abandoning, renouncing, AṣṭāvS.
abstaining from food, Bhaṭṭ.

सं-न्यासिन् m. one who abandons or resigns worldly affairs, an ascetic, devotee (who has renounced all earthly concerns and devotes himself, to meditation and the study of the Āraṇyakas or Upaniṣadas, a Brāhman in the fourth Āśrama [q.v.] or stage of his life, a religious mendicant; cf. RTL. 53, 55 &c.), Up.; MBh.; Pur.
a: संन्यासिन् — m. 1 One who lays down or deposits. --2 One who completely renounces the world and its attachments, an ascetic, a Brāhmaṇa in the fourth order of his religious life; ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न कांक्षति Bg. 5. 3. --3 One who abstains from food (त्यक्ताहार); Bk. 7. 76.

m: सं-न्यासि—संध्या f. N. of wk.
सं-न्यासि—समाराधन n. N. of wk.
सं-न्या˚सि-ता f. abandonment of worldly concerns, retirement from the world, MW.
सं-न्या˚सि-त्व n. abandonment of worldly concerns, retirement from the world, MW.
सं-न्या˚सोपनिषद् f. N. of wk.

सं-न्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति (rarely -असति), to, throw down together, place or put or lay together, ŚBr.; to impose, put or lay upon, intrust or commit to (gen. or loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to put or lay down, deposit, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to lay aside, give up, abandon, resign (esp. the world i.e. become an ascetic or Saṃnyāsin), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: संन्यस् — {c4c} P. 1 To place or put down, deposit. --2 To lay down or aside, give up, abandon, quit; तेन त्वया शस्त्रं न संन्यस्तव्यं V. 5; संन्यस्तशस्त्र R. 2. 59; संन्यस्ताभरणं गात्रं Me. 93; Ku. 7. 67. --3 To make or deliver over, entrust, commit to the care of; Bg. 3. 30. --4 To put together. --5 (Used intransitively) To resign the world, discard all worldly ties and attachments and become an anchorite, संदृश्य क्षणभंगुरं तदखिलं धन्यस्तु संन्यस्यति Bh. 3. 132.

m: सं-न्यसन n. throwing down, laying aside, giving up, resignation, renunciation of worldly concerns, Bhag.
a: संन्यसनं — 1 Resignation, laying down. --2 Complete renunciation of the world and its attachments; न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति Bg. 3. 4. --3 Consigning, entrusting to the care of. --4 Depositing.

m: सं-न्यस्त mfn. thrown down, laid aside, relinquished, abandoned, deserted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
encamped, R.
deposited, intrusted, consigned, ib.
a: संन्यस्त — p. p. 1 Laid or placed down. --2 Deposited. --3 Entrusted, consigned. --4 Laid aside, relinquished, renounced. --5 Encamped.

m: सं-न्यस्त—शस्त्र mfn. one who has laid aside his weapons, Ragh.
सं-न्यस्त—देह mfn. one who has given up his body, MW.
सं-न्युप्त mfn. (fr. सं-नि-√ वप्) thrown together.
